title: Gunpowder from sulfur spikes
description: Adds a recipe to make gunpowder by combining bonemeal, coal/charcoal and sulfur spikes.
body:
# What does this pack do?
This pack adds a recipe to make a gunpowder by combining sulfur spikes, bonemeal and any item with tag #coals (coal and charcoal in vanilla).

## Preview
![Animated preview of a recipe by combining coal/charcoal, sulfur spike and two bonemeal in a crafting window, resulting in two gunpowder.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5d3268219dea11a7b6f55ca69d133cf910ec3f9.gif)

### It's not balanced or recipe not as perfect as I want it.
You can download this pack and edit it as you want. I don't care, have fun in this blocky game.
